policy: a source with an alpha plane is refused (UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, reason alpha_not_preserved) for every operation that re-encodes through ffmpeg-skill/color without keeping the alpha; a stream copy keeps it and an output without it fails validation (alpha_lost). Where ffmpeg-skill/color has --keep-alpha, LUT_APPLY and PRIMARY_CORRECTION grade with the alpha kept (keep_alpha; docs/decisions.md ADR-25, ADR-30). The request says how the colour is stored (alpha_mode) and whether an opaque result is wanted instead (drop_alpha); a premultiplied source requires the engine source-alpha-mode capability for a grade that keeps the alpha

keep_alpha.precision: ffmpeg-skill/color keeps the alpha at 8 bits: a deeper source alpha comes back within one 8-bit code (a warning says so); an 8-bit alpha is bit-identical
keep_alpha.not_detected: a VP9 stream with an alpha layer probes as yuv420p through ffmpeg-skill/probe: it is graded without --keep-alpha and color's failed alpha step makes it a VALIDATION_ERROR (alpha_lost)
keep_alpha.premultiplied_source: graded in straight colour and written premultiplied with source-alpha-mode support; otherwise refused (alpha_premultiplied)
keep_alpha.verification: ffmpeg-skill/color's alpha step (written alpha against the source's, every frame) must pass, else VALIDATION_ERROR (alpha_lost / alpha_mismatch / alpha_unverified); the output must store an alpha plane
keep_alpha.output: the alpha line's pixel format (e.g. yuva444p12le for ProRes 4444) with the source's colour tags, not yuv420p
keep_alpha.recorded_as: alpha {kept, precision_bits, alpha_codec, alpha_mode, source_colour, tool, verification, alpha_mode_selection} in results and provenance

rules.request: the request named it (project.source.alpha_mode, always wins)
rules.format: not in the request; the source's format fixes it (PNG stores straight, unassociated alpha)
rules.assumed: not in the request and the source's format does not state it: taken as straight, with a warning

alpha_mode.detection: an alpha plane is read from ffprobe's pix_fmt through ffmpeg-skill/probe (pix_fmt_pattern); no format field that probe reports says whether the colour is premultiplied, so only a format whose specification fixes it (PNG: straight) gives a default
alpha_mode.straight: LUT_APPLY / PRIMARY_CORRECTION grade the colour with the alpha kept (keep_alpha)
alpha_mode.premultiplied: LUT_APPLY / PRIMARY_CORRECTION require source-alpha-mode support while alpha is kept (otherwise alpha_premultiplied); RETAG / STRIP_DOVI copy it unchanged; drop_alpha flattens it
alpha_mode.recorded_as: alpha_mode_selection {alpha_mode, rule, format_states, codec} in plan.alpha, plan steps, and the alpha record of results and provenance

drop_alpha.effect: every re-encoding operation on an alpha input writes the opaque H.264 line on purpose (none is refused for the alpha); RETAG / STRIP_DOVI still copy the stream and must keep the alpha
drop_alpha.verification: the written file must store no alpha plane (alpha_not_dropped); color's alpha step may report alpha_dropped, any other failure is a VALIDATION_ERROR
drop_alpha.colour: kept as stored: a premultiplied source reads as composited over black, a straight one shows the colour its transparent pixels hold
drop_alpha.uses: ffmpeg-skill/color --drop-alpha where detected (ffmpeg-skill/color:drop-alpha); without it the same opaque line is written and color's alpha step reporting alpha_dropped is expected
drop_alpha.recorded_as: alpha {kept: false, dropped: true, requested_by, tool, reported_dropped, verification, alpha_mode_selection}

output_settings: an output that keeps the alpha with an expect.pix_fmt that has no alpha plane is refused before anything runs (alpha_not_preserved); the alpha line must fit the source's container (containers)
